book.name: Marcos
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Marcos

content: To Pananglitan to mgo Saup
Dajun ikagi si Jesus to pananglitan duon to mgo otow no nahimun, “Meyduon otow no migtanom to ubas
duon to uma din. Piglibong din to kural aw hinangi to pogaanan to bogas to ubas dow turi no bantajanan. Tapus to sikan, pigpasaupan din aw panow diya to madiyu.
Anoy man no oggunuon on to mgo ubas, migsugu sikan tag-iya to suguonon din to pagpudut to kabahinan din.
Di pagtidow to sikan sinugu, dajun sikandin bukbuka to sikan mgo saup aw pabalika no ampan dae.
Dajun isab sugu sikan tag-iya to yain no suguonon, di pigpapakuy sikandin aw pakasikawi.
Tapus to sikan, yain isab no suguonon to pigsugu to sikan tag-iya, di pighimatajan dan. Mahan-in pad to duma no pigsugu to sikan tag-iya, di meyduon pigbukbuk dan, aw to duma pigpanghimatajan.
Na, iyan nanda wada kasugu to pinadajag din no anak. Sikandin to katapusan no pigsugu su ginhawa din, ‘Ogtahudon dan man yagboy seini anak ku.’
Di pagkita kandin to sikan mgo saup, mig-iling sikandan, ‘Suja anak to ogpakairinsya to seini ubasan ko mamatoy to amoy din. Na, oghimatajan ta isab agun ita on seini.’
Dajun dan himataji aw itimbag diya to yuwas to ubasan.
“Na,” kagi ni Jesus, “to paghona-hona now, og-amonu man sikan tag-iya? Og-andiyaon din sikan mgo saup aw panghimataji. Pagkatapus, ogpasaupan din sikan ubasan to yain no mgo otow.
Ajaw og-ilinga no wada kow makabasa to Kasuyatan to Diyus no pig-iling,

content.text: ‘Sikan batu no pig-ojowan to mgo pandoy
su nailing to boot dan no wada pues

content: Pagdinog to sikan mgo inila to tinuuhan to pananglitan ni Jesus, nasabutan dan no sikandan to pig-igu. Kaling ogdakopon dan podom sikandin, di nahaedok sikandan to mgo otow no naminog kandin. Dajun panow sikan mgo inila.
To Pagbajad to Buhis
Wada kayugoy, pigsugu dan diya ki Jesus to mgo Pariseo hasta to mgo sakup to partidu ni Hari Herodes agun no mabitik dan sikandin.

Pigduguk dan si Jesus. “Sir,” kagi dan, “namaan koy no matinod-anon ka aw matuud yagboy to impang-anad nu bahin to pagtuman to Diyus. Inggad hintawa to igpag-atubang nu, pinag-angod nu to pagpang-anad kandan su wada ogpayabihon nu. Na,” kagi dan, “meyduon ig-usip noy ikow. Kona buwa no supak to tinuuhan ta to pagbajad to buhis diya to hari to Roma? Ogbajad ki ko kona?”
Di namaan si Jesus no madoot to tuud dan, kaling pig-ikagihan din sikandan, “Nokoy no og-antihan a now man? Mey saepi now duon? Aha ki.”
Dajun dan tadwaji si Jesus to saepi. Mig-usip si Jesus, “Hintawa man bayhu
dow ngadan to nakabotang kani?” Migtabak sikandan, “Kaning hari to Roma.”
“Na,” kagi ni Jesus, “ibogoy diya to hari to kaning hari, aw ibogoy isab diya to Diyus to kaning Diyus.” Hilabi sikandan naboyong to sikan pagtabak din.
To Pagkabanhaw to mgo Patoy
Tapus to sikan, meyduon isab mgo Saduseo no mig-anduon ki Jesus su ogpangusip. Na, sikan no mgo otowa naman-iling no kona ogkabanhaw to mgo patoy.

Kagi dan, “Sir, mig-iling to balaod no imbilin ni Moises ita no ko mamatoy to otow no ogkabilin to asawa no wada pad anak, kinahangyan asawahon to suun din sikan bohi agun meyduon ogkailing no liwat to diya namatoy.
Na, igpananglit ta to pitu no migsusuun no mgo yukos. Naminyo sikan panganoy, di wada pad anak dan, namatoy on sikandin.
Sikan migsunu naminyo to sikan bayu aw namatoy isab no wada anak. Angod da isab to nahitabu to sikan ikatoyu no suun.
Na, yaktod no pagkaikagi, sikan pitu no migsusuun tibo nakaasawa to sikan bohi aw tibo sikandan namatoy no wada anak. To katapusan namatoy isab sikan bohi.
Na, ojow nu pa, ogbanhawon to mgo patoy. Ko matuman on sikan, hintawa man yagboy to sikan pitu to ogkatawag no tag-asawa to sikan bohi, su tibo man sikandan nakaasawa kandin?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Pagkasajop now yagboy! Su wada kow makasabut to Kasuyatan to Diyus dow to gahom din.
Su ko banhawon on to mgo patoy, wadad on og-inasawahay, su ogkaangod on man sikandan to mgo anghil diya to yangit.

Na, sikiyu no kona ogtuu no ogkabanhaw to mgo patoy, ajaw og-ilinga no wada kow makabasa to sinuyat ni Moises bahin to diya masagkop no kaju no duon sikandin ikagihi to Diyus no mig-iling, ‘Siak to Diyus no iyan ogsimbahon ni Abraham, ni Isaac dow ni Jacob.’

Migpasabut no inggad nayugoy da kamatoy sikan no mgo otow, buhi sikandan diya to yangit aw ogpadajun to pagsimba to Diyus. Su to mgo patoy konad ogsimba to Diyus, mgo buhi da. Kaling nasajop kow yagboy,” kagi ni Jesus.
To Pinakaimpurtanti no mgo Sugu to Diyus

Meyduon maistru to tinuuhan no nakaanduon dow migdinog to pagbitik podom ki Jesus. Pagpaniid din no madojow to pagkatabak ni Jesus to sikan mgo Saduseo, migpadani sikandin aw usip, “Duon to sikan tibo mgo balaod to Diyus, andei man to pinakaimpurtanti?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Sikan pinakaimpurtanti no sugu pig-iling, ‘Sikiyu no mgo kaliwat ni Israel, paminog kow. To Ginuu no Diyus ta sobuuk da.
Higugmaon now sikandin to bug-us no ginhawa dow hona-hona now aw tibuuk no kinabuhi dow doson now.’
Aw seini to ikaduwa no pinakaimpurtanti no sugu: ‘Higugmaa to isigkaotow now angod to paghigugma to kaugalingon now.’
Wada inggad nokoy no sugu no ogyabow pad to seini daduwa.”
Kagi to sikan maistru, “Madojow to pagkatabak nu Sir. Matuud iyan to pig-ikagi nu no sobuuk da to Diyus aw wadad on yain.

Tinood isab to pig-ikagi nu no kinahangyan higugmaon ta sikandin to bug-us no ginhawa dow hona-hona dow doson ta, aw kinahangyan higugmaon ta to isigkaotow ta angod to paghigugma to kaugalingon ta. Sikan daduwa no mgo sugu yabow no impurtanti kay to paghalad to ogtutungon no mgo mananap dow to duma no igbogoy diya to Diyus.”
Pagdinog ni Jesus to sikan madojow no pagkaikagi to sikan maistru, mig-iling sikandin, “Madani kad ogkasakup to sikan ogharian to Diyus.” Tapus to sikan, wadad on migyangub to pagpangusip ki Jesus.
Sikan Insaad no Manyuyuwas
No mang-anad si Jesus duon to Bayoy to Diyus, mig-ikagi sikandin, “Nang-anad to mgo maistru to tinuuhan ta bahin to diya Insaad no Manyuyuwas.
Na, nokoy no og-iling man sikandan no kaliwat puli sikandin ni Hari David
no si David no manduan to Ispiritu Santu iyan man yagboy mig-iling,

content.text: ‘To Ginuu no Agayon ku pig-ikagihan to Diyus,
Ingkud ka kani to kalintuu no takidingan ku
kotob no daogon ku yagboy to mgo kuntra nu
aw makayuhud duon to atubangan nu.’

content: Kagi ni Jesus, “Manno Agayon to intawag ni David to sikan Insaad no Manyuyuwas, nokoy no ogkailing man no kaliwat puli sikandin ni David?” Tibo nalipay to kaotawan to pagpaminog ki Jesus.
To Pamatasan to mgo Maistru to Tinuuhan

Duon to pagpang-anad ni Jesus, mig-ikagi sikandin, “Bantoy kow to mgo maistru to tinuuhan ta. Ogganahan sikandan ogpangabo to mahaba aw pakita-kita, aw ogtukhow ko pakitaon to pagtahud duon to karsada.
Ko duon sikandan to pagkoonan dow ko diya isab to simbahan, ogkaliyag sikandan og-ingkud duon to ingkudanan no ighinaat to mgo inila.

Di ogpangyupig sikandan to bayu no mgo bohi agun maagow to katigajunan dan, aw sikan madoot no hinang dan ogtakyuban to mahaba no mgo pag-ampu. Kaling kahaedokanan yagboy to kastigu no igpahamtang kandan.”
To Paghalad to Pubri no Bayu

No duon pad si Jesus to Bayoy to Diyus, mig-iingkud sikandin duon to naatubangan to taguanan to halad, aw pigsayapan din to mgo otow no namanhalad duon. Mahan-in to mgo sapian no nang-uyug to madogi no saepi duon.
Monok on no meyduon bohi no bayu no pubri hilabi no iyan da ingkauyug to daduwa no mangkaintok no saepi.
Dajun sabiha ni Jesus to mgo inanad din aw ikagihi, “Oho, to tibo mighalad, iyan yabow to halad to suja pubri no bohi.
Su tibo sikandan migbogoy to subra dan, di suja bohi no ogkalisod-lisod, imbogoy din to tibo ogkabuhian din.”
